# The Audacity

An Agentic Engineering Studio: a software house where AI agents do the engineering and senior judgment owns architecture, security and quality. We take an idea to a deployed product in weeks, not a slide deck.

Our mission: ship production software at studio quality and agent speed, so founders and teams get real, running products instead of prototypes, decks or hours billed.

Tagline: AI agents build. One human ensures quality.

## What we do

Agentic engineering: software designed, written, tested and shipped by orchestrated AI agents, inside human-owned architecture, code review and security gates. We sell delivered, running software (product builds, agent systems built into a business, build-and-run retainers), not hours, staff augmentation or advice.

The headline offer is the Studio Sprint: a fixed-scope, milestone-priced build that puts a running product into production. Every build includes sign-up and login, a database, launch on the web or app stores, and automatic releases (continuous delivery), with payments and analytics when you need them. The price and deadline go in the contract before any code. A deposit books your start date, then you pay per finished milestone.

Every build runs on that one repeatable spine, proven on our own products. The Launch package adds an AI assistant, analytics with cookie consent, and payments when needed.

## The offer and prices

- Studio Sprint: Pilot. Test one idea with real users. One user flow built end to end, on web or mobile, with login and data, live in production with automatic releases. 2 to 3 weeks. EUR 6k to 10k. Fixed price, paid per milestone.
- Studio Sprint: Launch. A product ready for users or investors. Several user flows on web and mobile, login and data, an AI assistant, analytics with cookie consent, payments when needed, launch on the web or app stores with automatic releases. 4 to 6 weeks. EUR 15k to 30k. Fixed price, paid per milestone.
- Build Partner Retainer. Keep shipping after launch, with the studio building your roadmap. Senior review of architecture and security on a fixed monthly rhythm. From EUR 4k a month. Monthly, cancel anytime.
- AI-Readiness & Build Audit. A fixed-scope audit of your idea, your existing code or your AI plans, delivered as a written report you can act on. About 1 week. EUR 1.5k to 3k.

Each package states what is included. Anything outside that scope is priced in writing before we build it, so the deadline stays the same. You own the code and intellectual property on final payment.

## Proof

Proof starts with three products of our own. Client work follows as it ships.

- Bloop. Own product, in build and piloting in Bologna. An AI concierge app that finds events and things to do in your city. You chat in plain language and it proposes real events from a live catalogue, never invented ones. Italian first, with English, and a web admin for curating the catalogue. It shows we can build an AI assistant your users talk to in plain language, and have it answer from your own live data.
- Washiiba. Own product, built end to end. A full marketplace platform for laundry: a customer mobile app for ordering, pickup windows and live order status, a supplier web portal where laundries accept and handle orders, and an admin back office for managing orders, suppliers and users. Each order is offered to suppliers automatically, and the customer app runs in six languages. It shows we can build every side of a marketplace: the app customers use, the portal suppliers work in and the back office the operator runs it from.
- Kerf. Own product, a case study on public data. Kerf turns free national LiDAR (IGN LiDAR HD in France) into a ranked list of overhead-line spans where vegetation is inside the clearance zone, measured in metres, then a work order for trimming crews. It is made for small electricity distributors and vegetation management contractors. We built a LiDAR processing pipeline, a web map viewer with the ranked span list and per-span measurements, work order export (CSV) and a printable report. The case-study run covers 345 spans on 28.4 km of overhead line: 829.5 million LiDAR points, scanned in June 2021, processed in 83 seconds on one server. It shows we can take raw public data to a ranked, measured result and a work order. Kerf is not yet validated in the field and has no paying customer. Its own site: https://projectkerf.com
- Recovery Room. A pilot, live at a gym in Cagliari. Booking for the gym's massage chairs and pressotherapy. A booking page for phones, Italian first with English: pick a seat and a time, with no app and no password. A staff page with the day's schedule, no-show counts and the member list. Confirmation emails come from the gym's own address and bookings sync to its Google Calendar. It shows we can get a small business a working tool in days, on its real member list.

## Who this is not for

The studio fits when you want a working product in production, one studio to own delivery, and a partner with opinions on scope and architecture. It is not the right fit when you want the lowest bid, when your scope is still open and you would rather pay by the hour, or when you need developers to add to your own team. We are not a fractional CTO practice, a staff-augmentation or body-shop agency, a no-code shop or a strategy consultancy.
